purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Mellit

queries.query: Mellit Sudan cadastral parcel map official land registry
queries.result: No Mellit-specific first-party parcel viewer or public parcel API was found. Results identified Sudan's national Judiciary/Aqari land-registration platform and a national spatial-portal description, but neither exposed a Mellit parcel response in the observed material.

queries.query: مليط السودان السجل العقاري خريطة كادسترية أراضي رسمية
queries.result: Arabic results identified the official Judiciary/Aqari national land-registration platform, Sudan Judiciary land-registration administration material, and a Sudan state surveying page. They establish national/state land-registration or surveying functions but no Mellit-specific public parcel layer or anonymous geometry endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official Sudan Judiciary-linked Aqari page describes a national platform for land and real-estate registration and services; no public map, parcel schema, Mellit route, or anonymous geometry was exposed in the observed page.

Official National Information Center page describes Sudan's national spatial portal and says it provides OGC WMS/WFS services; the linked geoportal host was not reachable from this environment and no service URL or parcel layer was verified.
Sudan Judiciary land-registration administration material describes central and branch registration offices and procedures, but is general national prose rather than Mellit-specific service evidence.
Official Gezira State urban-planning ministry page describes cadastral surveying and local surveying offices in Gezira State; it is not a Mellit or North Darfur registry and provides no parcel API.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified request reached the host but returned HTTP 502 from openresty; no login, retry with credentials, or TLS exception was used. Search-indexed first-party page was separately inspected and contained no public parcel endpoint.

First-party page was reachable through web inspection and described WMS/WFS capability plus a link to https://www.geoportal.gov.sd/; no concrete service endpoint or parcel layer was exposed in the inspected content.
TLS-verified direct requests failed DNS resolution for the host from this environment; no endpoint was inferred and no certificate exception was used.
Search discovery identified the first-party page, but direct/web fetch returned HTTP 521/unknown status; no parcel endpoint was exposed or inferred.
First-party state ministry surveying page was reachable in web inspection; it contained explanatory cadastral-survey prose and login fields but no public map/API route. No login was attempted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sudan national land-registration and spatial-portal services were identified, but Mellit coverage was not evidenced.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Mellit parcel response, stable native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The geoportal may expose OGC services when reachable, and local North Darfur/Mellit records may exist offline or behind an authenticated workflow. No exact-point or map-extent miss was used as absence evidence. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or unsafe fields were requested or retained. No GeoJSON sample is included because no safe native parcel identity and polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
